interface.title: AstroStretch
interface.stage_of_work: Quick look and visualisation of raw FITS telescope images, plus figure export for presentations
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a FITS image (the built-in synthetic nebula or your own upload), view the original and a stretched version side by side, tune the stretch method, the black/white point percentiles and the stretch strength against a pixel-value histogram, and export the stretched view as a PNG.

data.note: The built-in synthetic sample (astrostretch_test_nebula.fits, 512×512, median 1,007.80, dynamic range 5,452.12, OBJECT 'Synthetic Nebula Test'; filter, exposure and date 'Not recorded') loads by default. The same file was also uploaded through 'Upload my own FITS image' and gave identical statistics. Two PNGs with the same name were downloaded (astrostretch_test_nebula_stretched.png). The first, taken at Asinh strength 2, was 539,367 bytes (binary). The size of the second was not read.

features.name: Side-by-side raw vs transformed image comparison
features.general: Show the untouched data next to a processed rendering that updates live as the processing settings change
features.specific: The Original view and the '<Method> stretch' panel are shown together. The right panel and its heading redraw whenever the method, percentiles or strength change. Each panel also carries Streamlit's generic Fullscreen button.
steps: compare the Original view with the stretched panel
optionally open the stretched panel with Streamlit's Fullscreen button and press Escape
serves_tasks: Compare alternative intensity transforms side by side with the raw view
Inspect the processed image at full size

features.name: Selectable intensity transform with a dependent strength parameter
features.general: Choose among several value-mapping functions. A strength parameter is enabled only for the functions that use it, and a one-line explanation updates with the choice.
features.specific: The Stretch method dropdown (Linear / Logarithmic / Asinh) with the Stretch strength slider (1–20), which greys out for Linear. A caption describes each method.
steps: judge background vs faint structure in the stretched panel
serves_tasks: Compare alternative intensity transforms side by side with the raw view
Tune transform strength to trade faint-signal visibility against background brightening

features.name: Percentile clipping linked to a histogram with limit markers
features.general: Set the lower and upper display limits as percentiles of the data and see them drawn as vertical lines on a log-count histogram of the bulk of the data, so that outliers can be excluded on purpose
features.specific: The Black point percentile (0–10) and White point percentile (90–100) sliders drive the red and blue lines on the Pixel-value histogram. The histogram has a log count axis, and its bars are trimmed to the 0.1–99.9 percentile range. At a white point of 100% the x-axis extends to the maximum pixel value (about 6,400).
steps: drag or key-step (arrows, Home/End, step 0.1) the Black point percentile
drag or key-step the White point percentile
see the red/blue lines move on the histogram
check the stretched image for clipping or saturation
serves_tasks: Clip the display range so that a few extreme values do not dominate
Check where the display limits fall on the data distribution

features.name: Data source chooser (bundled example or upload)
features.general: Toggle between a built-in demo dataset and a user upload, with a banner confirming what is loaded
features.specific: The 'Choose an image source' radio ('Try the sample image' / 'Upload my own FITS image') with a FITS uploader (200MB, .fits/.fit/.fts) and a 'Loaded <file>' banner. Removing the file with the x returns to the 'Upload a telescope image to begin.' prompt.
steps: choose 'Try the sample image' or 'Upload my own FITS image'
optionally remove the file with the x

features.name: Dataset summary: size, usable pixels, median and dynamic range, plus collapsible header metadata
features.general: Show headline summary statistics for the loaded data, with descriptive metadata available in a collapsible section
features.specific: Four metrics (Image size, Usable pixels, Median value, Dynamic range) and the 'FITS details' expander (Object, Filter, Exposure, Observation date; missing values show 'Not recorded')
serves_tasks: Check the size and summary statistics of the data

features.name: Export the rendered view as an image
features.general: Download exactly the processed rendering currently on screen as a presentation image, leaving the source data untouched
features.specific: 'Download stretched PNG' saves <name>_stretched.png of the current stretch. The caption says the original FITS measurements are not changed.
steps: repeat after changing settings or source to get another PNG
serves_tasks: Save the processed display image for presentation
